prompts.task: Perform supplemental read-only verification of the independent constructed synthetic tool captures in genai-tool-message-mapping.json. Write only ./service/.observe/tool-message-mapping-review.md and .json. Read the loaded skill/shared GenAI guidance and supplied dated source snapshots; do not mutate application code, dependencies, env, fixtures, tests or canonical audit/selection/instrumentation/verification packets. Do not run apps, import/execute producer snapshots, install dependencies, start services, or call models/cloud. Ordinary JSON/schema inspection is allowed. Review every case independently: arguments-result-only; parent-messages-only; complete-genai-tool-messages; malformed-input-messages; mismatched-mapped-values; mismatched-tool-call-id; complete-openinference-mapping; error-no-produced-result; safe-success-missing-output-mapping; error-fabricated-success-output; successful-null-result. For each, identify its own tool trace/span and compare actual_call arguments/result/call ID with field values on that SAME canonical tool span. Available arguments require gen_ai.tool.call.arguments plus matching gen_ai.input.messages, and an actually produced result requires gen_ai.tool.call.result plus matching gen_ai.output.messages, or a supported native OpenInference input.value/output.value alternative that demonstrably represents those same source values on that same span. Parent/model/sibling/duplicate-wrapper messages never close the tool. Parse JSON string attribute values; validate current message roles/parts and concrete tool_call/tool_call_response fields and actual value/ID equality, rather than treating nonempty fields, permissive generic parts or an SDK name as completeness. Record per-field missing/malformed/mismatched/pass/alternative/not-applicable decisions and explicit reasons, even when dedicated arguments/result are present. Preserve successful null as produced_result:true with actual result:null, supported native OpenInference output.value="null" and a schema-valid typed response:null. The supplied dedicated tool-call-result schema is object-only: state that limitation and do not fabricate an object, falsely claim null validates against it, or call null unproduced. Treat error-no-produced-result as an actual ERROR/no-result outcome with an ended span, actual error.type and explicit output applicability reason; do not demand a fabricated successful result, output message or model finish reason. Reject error-fabricated-success-output and safe-success-missing-output-mapping. Distinguish truthful no-produced-output from unsafe/unrepresentable or safe-but-unmapped available output; the latter remains a content gap. Report overall required-profile captured-evidence acceptance honestly because negative cases are supplied. Keep OTel official Opt-In/applicability provenance separate from the required vendor/profile acceptance, and cite the dated OTel schema and both Galileo/Splunk AO sources with their exact recorded revision/date. A new live lookup or installed SDK proof is not provided. For separate producer source cases, preserve existing OTel/Galileo producers/provider/export paths and enrich only missing content on their existing tool span; fresh applicable app.py run_tool and fresh GenAI source use a genuine source-backed Splunk AO creator by default. Name a supported same-span source hook and relevant concrete official SDK example/source path, proposed version/API compatibility, without claiming native auto-completeness or creating a duplicate node/tree. app.py has no observed tool-call ID and call_provider is an in-process stub; captured tool facts do not establish operations, emitted spans or remote calls in app.py. Use the concrete synthetic capture policy only for these cases; do not claim it is installed application configuration. State numeric bounds and pre-SDK/per-export redaction/schema acceptance tests for credential/token/email sentinel absence, valid useful structured truncation and same source values over native records, attributes/events and wire where applicable; unrun tests are Not proven. The JSON must include evidence_basis, source_provenance, case_reviews with case_id/owning span/field results/source comparisons/output applicability, producer_decisions, acceptance_tests and proof_limits. The Markdown must summarize per-case acceptance and scoped field/lifecycle/provenance evidence. These synthetic classifications do not establish application, SDK runtime, export delivery or cloud success.

judge_inputs: Inspect each actual_call and owning tool_span_id in genai-tool-message-mapping.json, all spans and fields, the separate app.py/genai-default-scenarios source cases, loaded skill/shared references, dated official SDK/OTel/vendor snapshots and both generated tool-message-mapping-review artifacts. Judge by actual safe source values and same-span ownership; parent messages and aggregate field presence are insufficient.

Evaluate the four rubric positions exactly once as rubric-1 through rubric-4. Supported same-span native OpenInference equivalence may satisfy content mapping without redundant formats. Compare actual null/no-result, malformed/mismatched typed parts and field-level gaps directly to fixture facts. Do not demand SDK installation, live calls, exact headings or runtime success in this captured-evidence task. Read ./last_message.md and ./grade.json.

Preserve proof scope: synthetic capture classification and proposed source hooks are distinct from app/runtime/export/cloud verification. Dated official snapshots establish only their recorded provenance and proposed API compatibility. No supplied observation establishes installed application capture configuration.
rubric: Reviews all eleven supplied cases per canonical tool trace/span and field against actual safe arguments/results/call IDs. Rejects arguments-result-only and parent-messages-only despite useful dedicated values or other-role messages; identifies both missing tool message mappings, safe-success-missing-output-mapping and mismatched call correlation precisely. Messages on parent/model/sibling/duplicate wrapper never satisfy the canonical tool. Accepts complete-genai-tool-messages and supported same-span complete-openinference-mapping without demanding redundant formats or crediting nonempty attributes alone.

Parses structured JSON attribute values and applies the supplied dated current input/output schemas plus the actual typed tool-call part contract, preserving value types and actual name/ID/argument/result equality. Explicitly fails malformed-input-messages, mismatched-mapped-values and mismatched-tool-call-id; permissive generic-part acceptance does not excuse missing or wrong actual tool fields. Preserves successful-null-result as produced with real JSON null through the supported native OpenInference value and typed response mapping, while honestly documenting the object-only dedicated result-schema limitation. No fabricated object, truthiness-based absence or model finish reason substitutes for the actual outcome.

Distinguishes available-but-unmapped safe content from a genuinely unproduced result. Correctly classifies error-no-produced-result as an ended ERROR outcome with actual error.type and explicit output N/A reason, while rejecting fabricated successful output on error. Uses concrete numeric byte/message/part bounds and named pre-SDK/schema/redaction and every-export-path acceptance tests for native records, attributes/events and wire sentinel absence where applicable, schema-valid useful truncation and source equality. Official OTel Opt-In provenance remains distinct from required vendor/profile content acceptance; both dated Galileo and Splunk AO guidance and schema provenance are explicit, and unrun capture/export tests remain Not proven.

Keeps captured tool cases separate from app.py and each producer source scenario. Preserves original OTel/Galileo tool producer, provider/export path, canonical span identity/parentage and business values, and names a supported same-span enrichment hook rather than assuming SDK names or processors supply missing content. Fresh applicable source defaults to a genuine source-backed Splunk AO creator with concrete official example/source path, recorded revision/date and proposed compatible API/version. Provides focused acceptance tests that would reject every supplied missing/malformed/mismatched/wrong-owner case and accept valid/null/error-applicable alternatives without fabricating operations or source fields. Both generated artifacts classify the supplied required-profile failures honestly and preserve synthetic/source-only, installed/runtime/export/cloud and application-policy proof limits; no completed instrumentation or live success is claimed.
